high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by a user named "nimmikavleen," located in Jacó, Costa Rica. The post features a woman standing outdoors in a tropical setting, surrounded by lush green foliage and some red flowers. She is wearing a white and black striped bikini with a halter top and matching bottoms. Her accessories include a large, ornate necklace and a bracelet on her left arm. The woman has long, dark hair that falls over her shoulders and is looking to the side with a confident expression.
